verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a full time-off request lifecycle — balance checking, submission, admin approval, and payroll integration — via the time_off_request_management flow or direct approve/decline endpoints (gusto-docs-11, gusto-docs-19, gusto-docs-29, gusto-docs-52). However, there's no explicit documentation of defining/configuring accrual policies (accrual rates, tiers, carryover rules) themselves — only consuming/approving balances that already exist. Missing for 10: documentation of PTO policy creation/configuration (accrual rules), evidence of automatic accrual calculation logic, and hands-on/independent confirmation that approvals flow correctly into payroll runs.
